reading.requirement: Current exact source SHA and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Question evidence uses spoken transcript spans only. Canonical source usage, official paired Conversation audio, rights and alignment gates remain required. No actual independent audio listen was performed during question authoring.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same-source text/audio share one group. These public practice candidates are not independent assessment or unseen-transfer evidence.

questions.prompt: What does Anna plan to do tonight?
questions.evidence: Tonight I am going to the theater with my friends.
questions.explanation: Anna明确说今晚要和朋友去theater。开头虽然介绍人们晚上也会去餐馆或听音乐，但那些是一般活动举例，不能当成Anna这晚自己的计划。

spokenEvidence.quote: Tonight I am going to the theater with my friends.

questions.prompt: Why does Genie say no to jeans and a T-shirt?
questions.evidence: Jeans and a t-shirt are too casual. How about something more formal?
questions.explanation: Genie说牛仔裤和T恤too casual，并建议更正式的衣服，因此问题是过于休闲。too small是在后面对绿色连衣裙的评价，颜色不搭也是另一套衣服的问题，都不能移到最初建议上。

spokenEvidence.quote: Jeans and a t-shirt are too casual. How about something more formal?

questions.prompt: What does Anna say about the size of the green dress?
questions.evidence: But it’s not the right size. It’s too small.
questions.explanation: Anna明确说这条连衣裙尺码不对、too small，所以是太小。太大是后来绿色衬衫的问题；原文not the right size也排除了尺码正好的选项。

spokenEvidence.quote: But it’s not the right size. It’s too small.

questions.prompt: What clothing size does Genie recommend for Anna?
questions.evidence: Yes, the right size for you is medium.
questions.explanation: Genie明确说适合Anna的是medium，因此填medium。前面出现too small和too large是试穿问题，不是最后推荐的尺码；本题使用说出的尺寸，不凭人物画面判断身材。

spokenEvidence.quote: Yes, the right size for you is medium.

questions.prompt: Near the end, what does Genie tell Anna to take off?
questions.evidence: Mm, take off the hat. That’s better.
questions.explanation: Genie最后明确要求take off the hat。金色腰带是Anna要求加上的配饰，原文没有在此要求取下；领带出现在更早的不合适装扮中，不是这句take off针对的物品。

spokenEvidence.quote: Mm, take off the hat. That’s better.

questions.prompt: Why does Genie not go to the theater with Anna?
options: Genie has other friends to help.
answers: Genie has other friends to help.
questions.evidence: Sorry, Anna. I have to help other friends.
questions.explanation: Genie说必须帮助其他朋友，因此不能和Anna一起去。此前已经赞同最终的衣服效果，所以不能选不喜欢最终装扮；对话也没有说Genie找不到剧院。

spokenEvidence.quote: Sorry, Anna. I have to help other friends.

review.textEvidence: Codex item-by-item exact source evidence and language comparison

blindComparison.scope: Independent source-text blind solve before seeing keys. VOA12 then received an explicitly recorded punctuation-only source correction; all question facts and answers were rechecked unchanged.
